Scientific boundary

What this MVP can and cannot answer

The Gassum view uses 81 successful OPM Flow 2026.04 CO2STORE simulations: nine property realizations, three shared all-fault transmissibilities, and Alpha/Beta/Zeta unit responses. The 1–3 Mt/yr project controls use transparent unit-response superposition for regional screening.

All 29 supplied fault traces are represented as one vertical transmissibility set through the six Gassum layers. Storage Alpha, Beta and Zeta are screening placements rather than optimized or permit-ready well locations; Zeta is fixed at model Cell 682.

This remains a generic regional screening model, not a history-matched or permitting model. Decisions require calibrated geology and fluids, fault properties, coupled geomechanics, operational constraints, monitoring data, and qualified reservoir and geomechanics review.
